Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class IntelReportService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.IntelReportService
All Implemented Interfaces:
GenerateIntelReportUseCase
public class IntelReportService extends Object implements GenerateIntelReportUseCase
Domain service that orchestrates competitive intelligence report generation.

Pipeline:

  1. Run COMBINED research via ConductResearchUseCase to gather sources.
  2. Build an intel-report prompt from the gathered citations.
  3. Call AiReportPort for a deep-dive AI synthesis.
  4. Persist the resulting IntelReport via IntelReportPort.

This class has no Spring annotations — it is wired as a bean in AppConfig.
